title: Sanditon

vibeProfile.oneLine: Austen's unfinished last novel, sharp and funny, set at a booming spa town.

summary: Austen's final, unfinished novel opens on the newly fashionable seaside resort of Sanditon, where a hopeful speculator dreams of turning a sleepy village into a spa town, and a cast of hypochondriacs and schemers gathers around the bright young Charlotte Heywood. Austen wrote only a dozen sharp, funny chapters before her death, but they crackle with fresh energy and a new interest in money, health fads and property. A tantalising glimpse of where her genius might have gone next.
whyReadIt: Austen's last, unfinished novel, twelve crackling chapters cut short by her death. A tantalising glimpse of a new direction.

funFacts.text: Austen wrote only eleven or twelve chapters before illness forced her to stop.
